name: Cb monkeys
summary: Step into CB Monkeys, a chill yet chaotic Gorilla Tag fan game where every session brings new excitement! Start by playing the Only Up game mode and explore unique maps like the detailed spawn area and mysterious intro. Meet friendly characters like Someone VR and Mr. CB, who guide players through fun challenges. Staff members use special items to keep the game balanced, add hilarious twists, and make gameplay even more entertaining. With a rich story, an advanced TOS system, and plenty of secrets to uncove
